(fn ShouldRenderHeadlamp () 
 (bind health (Utilities|Casting|CastToAC_Health :Object (Actor|GetComponentbyClass :self (Components|GetOwner) :ComponentClass "/Game/Hazards/AC_Health.AC_Health_C"))
  (:then (bind dead (Class|ACHealth|IsDead :self health)) (bind blackout (CallFunction|IsVisualBlackout))
   (return (and (Variables|Default|GetHeadlampOn) (and (not dead) (not blackout))))) (:CastFailed (return false))))

(fn ApplyHeadlamp () 
 (bind pawn (Utilities|Casting|CastToPawn :Object (Components|GetOwner))
  (:then (bind light (Utilities|Casting|CastToSpotLightComponent :Object (Actor|GetComponentbyClass :self pawn :ComponentClass "/Script/Engine.SpotLightComponent"))
   (:then (bind visible (CallFunction|ShouldRenderHeadlamp))
    (Rendering|Components|Light|SetIntensity :self light :NewIntensity (select visible 2500.0 0.0))
    (Transformation|SetWorldRotation :self light :NewRotation (Pawn|GetBaseAimRotation :self pawn))) (:CastFailed))) (:CastFailed)))

(fn NextPresentationStyle () 
 (if (Networking|HasAuthority)
  (bind gs (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_CoopGameState :Object (Game|GetGameState))
   (:then (bind (index phase attempt ends row) (Utilities|Struct|BreakSRoundState :S_RoundState (Class|BPCoopGameState|GetRoundState :self gs)))
    (if (!= attempt (Variables|Default|GetPresentationAttempt)) (Variables|Default|SetPresentationAttempt attempt) (Variables|Default|SetPresentationStyleNumber 0) (Variables|Default|SetPresentationStyleOffset (Math|Random|RandomInteger :Max 3)))
    (bind style (% (+ (Variables|Default|GetPresentationStyleOffset) (Variables|Default|GetPresentationStyleNumber)) 3))
    (Variables|Default|SetPresentationStyleNumber (+ (Variables|Default|GetPresentationStyleNumber) 1))
    (return style)) (:CastFailed (return 0))) (else (return 0))))

(fn HideTakingPresentation () (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingArm) :bNewVisibility false) (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorLeft) :bNewVisibility false) (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorRight) :bNewVisibility false) (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorVoid) :bNewVisibility false) (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingShadowBody) :bNewVisibility false))

(fn RefreshTakingPresentation () 
 (Utilities|IsValid :InputObject (Variables|Default|GetVictim)
  (:"Is Valid" (bind gs (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_CoopGameState :Object (Game|GetGameState))
   (:then (bind age (- (GameState|GetServerWorldTimeSeconds :self gs) (Variables|Default|GetTakingStarted)))
    (bind active (and (>= age 0.0) (< age 0.65)))
    (bind outward (Math|Float|Clamp(Float) :Value (/ age 0.35) :Min 0.0 :Max 1.0))
    (bind inward (Math|Float|Clamp(Float) :Value (/ (- age 0.35) 0.3) :Min 0.0 :Max 1.0))
    (Transformation|SetActorRotation :NewRotation (Math|Rotator|MakeRotator :Yaw (+ (.yaw (Transformation|GetActorRotation :self (Variables|Default|GetVictim))) 180.0)))
    (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingArm) :bNewVisibility (and active (== (Variables|Default|GetScareStyle) 0)))
    (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingArm) :NewLocation (Utilities|Struct|MakeVector :X (- (+ -350.0 (* outward 101.0)) (* inward 180.0)) :Z -45.0) :bSweep false)
    (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorLeft) :bNewVisibility (and active (== (Variables|Default|GetScareStyle) 1)))
    (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorRight) :bNewVisibility (and active (== (Variables|Default|GetScareStyle) 1)))
    (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorVoid) :bNewVisibility (and active (== (Variables|Default|GetScareStyle) 1)))
    (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorLeft) :NewLocation (Utilities|Struct|MakeVector :Y (- 0.0 (+ 38.0 (* outward 95.0))) :Z 4.0) :bSweep false)
    (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorRight) :NewLocation (Utilities|Struct|MakeVector :Y (+ 38.0 (* outward 95.0)) :Z 4.0) :bSweep false)
    (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingFloorVoid) :NewLocation (Utilities|Struct|MakeVector :Z 5.0) :bSweep false)
    (Rendering|SetVisibility :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingShadowBody) :bNewVisibility (and active (== (Variables|Default|GetScareStyle) 2)))
    (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingShadowBody) :NewLocation (Utilities|Struct|MakeVector :X (+ -210.0 (* outward 95.0)) :Z -176.0) :bSweep false)
    (Transformation|SetRelativeRotation :self (Variables|Default|GetTakingShadowBody) :NewRotation (Math|Rotator|MakeRotator :Pitch (* outward -24.0)) :bSweep false)
    (if (and active (and (== (Variables|Default|GetScareStyle) 2) (>= age 0.2)))
     (for pawn (Actor|GetAllActorsOfClass :ActorClass "/Game/Core/BP_CoopCharacter.BP_CoopCharacter_C")
      (if (<= (Math|Vector|Distance(Vector) :V1 (Transformation|GetActorLocation :self pawn) :V2 (Variables|Default|GetVictimOrigin)) 1200.0)
       (bind playerView (Utilities|Casting|CastToAC_PlayerView :Object (Actor|GetComponentbyClass :self pawn :ComponentClass "/Game/Player/AC_PlayerView.AC_PlayerView_C"))
        (:then (Class|ACPlayerView|SetVisualBlackout :self playerView :EndAt (+ (Variables|Default|GetTakingStarted) 1.1))) (:CastFailed)))))) (:CastFailed (CallFunction|HideTakingPresentation))))
  (:"Is Not Valid" (CallFunction|HideTakingPresentation))))

(fn HideParentGhostVisual () 
 (for item (Actor|GetComponentsbyClass :self (Components|GetOwner) :ComponentClass "/Script/Engine.StaticMeshComponent")
  (bind mesh (Utilities|Casting|CastToStaticMeshComponent :Object item) (:then (Rendering|SetVisibility :self mesh :bNewVisibility false)) (:CastFailed)))
 (for item (Actor|GetComponentsbyTag :self (Components|GetOwner) :ComponentClass "/Script/Engine.StaticMeshComponent" :Tag "CaveBeingBody")
  (bind mesh (Utilities|Casting|CastToStaticMeshComponent :Object item) (:then (Rendering|SetVisibility :self mesh :bNewVisibility true)) (:CastFailed))))

(fn RefreshCaveBody () 
 (bind gs (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_CoopGameState :Object (Game|GetGameState))
  (:then (for item (Actor|GetComponentsbyTag :self (Components|GetOwner) :ComponentClass "/Script/Engine.StaticMeshComponent" :Tag "CaveBeingBody")
   (bind mesh (Utilities|Casting|CastToStaticMeshComponent :Object item)
    (:then (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation :self mesh :NewLocation (Utilities|Struct|MakeVector :Z (+ -96.0 (* (Math|Trig|Sin(Radians) :A (* (GameState|GetServerWorldTimeSeconds :self gs) 2.0)) 8.0))) :bSweep false)) (:CastFailed)))) (:CastFailed)))
